visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide, bright display of various strawberries in a Japanese supermarket. Tiers of plastic-packaged red strawberries are arranged in dark baskets and on white shelving. Large text overlays in Traditional Chinese and Japanese announce the strawberry season. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a specific shelf of strawberries labeled '980' yen. The camera moves slightly to the right, showing rows of neatly stacked rectangular plastic containers filled with bright red fruit under bright indoor retail lighting. (3) The perspective shifts to a wide aisle view of the supermarket produce section. Multiple freestanding displays and refrigerated shelves are visible, all stocked heavily with different varieties of strawberries. Social media watermarks remain visible at the top. (4) A macro close-up highlights 'Milky Berry' white strawberries, which are pale pinkish-white and priced at 2,300 yen per pack. The fruit is nestled in white protective foam inside clear plastic containers. (5) The camera cuts to a large display of deep red strawberries priced at 780 yen. The containers are meticulously aligned, featuring various labels and branding in Japanese text. The lighting creates highlights on the plastic packaging. (6) A closer shot shows red strawberries with a yellow '20% off' discount sticker. The camera zooms in slightly on the 'LOVE Berry' branding on the packaging, emphasizing the texture and color of the ripe fruit. (7) A person's hand enters the frame from the top left and carefully picks up one of the strawberry containers from a lower shelf. The hand has a natural skin tone and moves with a gentle, selective motion. (8) A tiered, circular green display stand features small plastic cups filled with cut strawberries and individual premium strawberries in pink protective mesh. The camera pans down to show the variety of snack-sized strawberry products. (9) The video concludes with a pink and white graphic end card featuring a logo of a strawberry, social media handles for 'japanuts', and icons for Facebook, Instagram, and a website link. Visual text encourages liking and sharing.
